free_text: The 68-year-old male has an elevated PSA of 21.0 ng/mL and a clinical T1c staging. MRI revealed a focal area of restricted diffusion in the left posterior peripheral zone, but no extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion was noted. Biopsy results are benign (Gleason 0+0, ISUP grade group 0), despite an AI prediction of grade group 4. Management assessment is continued surveillance, balancing the risk of progression against the potential side effects of intervention.
